module: University IP (MVP) — bring university-owned IP into the Wildfire app
note: Matrix-intent derived faithfully from the PO-approved intake (university-ip_intake.json, v4) and its acceptance_criteria. ROLE MAPPING (PO must confirm at the gate): (1) IP Manager is a genuinely NEW role column (no existing master column). (2) 'Wildfire Admin / Super Admin' is described in the intake as an EXISTING WFL staff role; it is PROPOSED here as a distinct 'Wildfire Admin' column only so the tool can carry its University-IP grants — the PO should decide whether to add a new column or fold these grants into the existing 'Super Admin' column. (3) Professor (idea owner) maps to the EXISTING 'Founder' column (Founder + university-IP-origin analytics tag) — NOT forced into a new column. (4) Founder / Co-founder (via Founder Match) maps to the EXISTING 'Founder' column — NOT forced into a new column. Founder-facing grants (browse/filter published Founder-Match ideas across universities, express interest, university-IP-origin analytics tag) apply to the EXISTING Founder column and therefore cannot be expressed as new-column ✅ by this tool; they are ADD-only grants the PO applies by hand to the existing Founder column.

new_roles.name: IP Manager
new_roles.definition: New university-side role (the VP of Research is merged in — ONE role, no separate VPR tab). Scoped to their own university's organization only (other universities are invisible). Brings the university's IP into the app, associates each idea with its professor, creates the professor's profile/account and sends the invite, flags professor involvement, chooses each idea's disposition (Founder / Hackathon / Founder Match / Hold), publishes, writes the tracking (notes, outcome, Founder-Match status) from the idea's IP profile, and tracks every idea across its route. Their role home is the home page they see at login.

new_roles.name: Wildfire Admin
new_roles.definition: PROPOSED COLUMN — the intake calls this 'Wildfire Admin / Super Admin', an EXISTING WFL staff role. Manages all universities/orgs: provisions university orgs, assigns/reassigns IP Managers, edits/removes a university, deactivates a university and/or people, and drills into each university (the detail page IS the management surface). PO DECISION NEEDED: add this as a new column, or fold these grants into the existing 'Super Admin' column instead.

capabilities.capability: Bring IP into the app (spreadsheet import or individual add); imported IP lands private by default
capabilities.rationale: AC — IP Manager / Import-add: an IP Manager can bring IP in and it lands private by default; an idea can be marked Hold at import.

capabilities.capability: Associate each idea with its professor and set the professor-involvement flag (co-founder vs contact)
capabilities.rationale: AC — IP Manager / Association: each imported idea is associated with a professor and carries the co-founder-vs-contact flag.

capabilities.capability: Create the professor's profile/account and send the invite (Professor + linked-IP-idea tag applied at account creation)
capabilities.rationale: AC — IP Manager / Professor invite (gate-2): from the idea, the IP Manager creates the professor's account with a Professor + linked-IP-idea tag.

capabilities.capability: Choose each idea's disposition — exactly one of Founder / Hackathon / Founder Match / Hold
capabilities.rationale: AC — IP Manager / Routing: an IP Manager can give each piece of IP exactly one of the four dispositions.

capabilities.capability: Mark/keep an idea Hold (private) until its disposition changes
capabilities.rationale: AC — IP Manager / Hold: an idea marked Hold stays private (not visible downstream) until the IP Manager changes its disposition.

capabilities.capability: Publish an idea to its destination(s) — Founder Match and/or hackathon-pickable
capabilities.rationale: AC — IP Manager / Publish: publishing moves an idea from private to the selected destination(s); unpublished IP is not visible downstream.

capabilities.capability: See tracking status per idea across its route (founder-route progress / hackathon build / founder-match)
capabilities.rationale: AC — IP Manager / Tracking: for each routed idea the IP Manager sees its status on its route via the existing founder-tracking framework.

capabilities.capability: Write/edit tracking notes, record/update the outcome, and move the Founder-Match status through the framework's existing stages from the idea's IP profile (dashboard reflects it)
capabilities.rationale: AC — IP Manager / Tracking write-back (gate-4): from the IP profile the IP Manager writes notes, records outcome, advances Founder-Match status; the dashboard reflects a single shared record per idea.

capabilities.capability: IP Portfolio detail shows an 'About this company / what it does' description
capabilities.rationale: AC — IP Manager / Detail description (gate-3): clicking a company/idea in the IP Portfolio shows a description of the company and what it does.

capabilities.capability: Receive founder-interest notifications and start making connections (connect founder ↔ professor)
capabilities.rationale: AC — IP Manager / Interest notifications (gate-3): when a founder expresses interest in this university's Founder-Match idea, the IP Manager is notified and starts making connections.

capabilities.capability: IP Manager role home is the home page seen at login
capabilities.rationale: AC — IP Manager / Home page (gate-3): the IP Manager role home is the login landing page.

capabilities.capability: Scoped to own university only — other universities and their IP are invisible (tenancy isolation)
capabilities.rationale: AC — Cross-cutting / Tenancy isolation: an IP Manager sees only their own university's org and IP; the Wildfire Admin sees all.

capabilities.capability: See and manage the universities in the system; provision a university org and assign its IP Manager
capabilities.rationale: AC — Wildfire Admin / Universities: a Wildfire Admin sees and manages universities, provisions an org, and assigns its IP Manager.

capabilities.capability: See per-university pipeline / volume — IP volume and disposition/publish breakdown
capabilities.rationale: AC — Wildfire Admin / Pipeline: the admin sees what's going through each university.

capabilities.capability: See who's attached to each university — IP Managers and professors (which professors tied to which university)
capabilities.rationale: AC — Wildfire Admin / People (gate-3): the admin sees who's attached and which professors are tied to which university.

capabilities.capability: Edit a university, remove a university, reassign an IP Manager, deactivate a university and/or people (confirmation on destructive actions)
capabilities.rationale: AC — Wildfire Admin / Manage (gate-3): edit/remove university, reassign IP Manager, deactivate — with a confirmation step on destructive actions.

capabilities.capability: Clickable per-university drill-down detail page (IP Managers, professors, ideas/pipeline, status, actions)
capabilities.rationale: AC — Wildfire Admin / Drill-down (gate-3): each university row is clickable into a deeper detail page.

capabilities.capability: Manage the university INSIDE its drill-down page — in-place edit form, deactivate/reactivate, remove, reassign/assign IP Managers, manage attached professors
capabilities.rationale: AC — Wildfire Admin / Manage inside the entity (gate-4): the drill-down page IS the management surface; fields edit in place and people are managed there.
